scope: Artifact loadability, PT/ONNX parity and end-to-end CPU pipeline execution. Not a detector-quality evaluation: no labeled ground truth, mAP or event-quality claim is made.

root_cause_of_hang.summary: Infinite loop in hansung_export_canonical.nms, reached from run_onnx during the first parity frame of hansung_finalize.py. No ONNX stage was slow.
root_cause_of_hang.exact_stage: hansung_finalize.py line 46 -> hansung_export_canonical.run_onnx line 85 -> nms line 53
root_cause_of_hang.mechanism: while idx.size: ... if rest.size: idx = rest[mask]. When a class reduced to a single surviving candidate, rest was empty, the update was skipped, idx never shrank and the loop appended the same index forever.
root_cause_of_hang.detected_by: var/tools/hansung_watchdog.py faulthandler stack dump after 40s of silence

output_contract.explanation: 14 channels = 4 box + 10 class scores. No separate objectness column.

canonicalization.implemented_in: edge/pipeline.py Detector.infer (scores the mapped source columns only, equivalent to a 3-class subset export)
canonicalization.metadata: var/model/hansung-p3.json sidecar; ONNX metadata left as the truthful 10-class source map

pt_onnx_parity.match_criterion: IoU>0.5, identical source class, abs(conf diff)<0.05

pipeline_execution.path: video -> Detector -> ByteTrack -> PPE association -> SafetyRule -> SQLite outbox
pipeline_execution.events_note: Only one no_helmet detection (0.419) occurred in the whole clip; the rule requires >=5 frames spanning >=2s, so zero events is the correct outcome, not a pipeline failure.
